e2e_failure.cause: The room engine places a mark at the scene anchor of the temporary M0 1.1 lines (site/tools/temp/living-room.nordic.json -> .generated/scene.living-room.nordic.json), else at the slot's own hotspot (web/src/components/RoomExperience.tsx anchorOf). The holder is 'not present in the temporary image' (no anchor, no outline). Since slots 1.7 (665e4521, 2026-11-05, M0S2) the slot has a visible M0 1.2 point; 1.8 (31db44ce) moved it to (0.378, 0.92). So at 1280 a mark shows at (456, 658) over a 1.1 image with no holder, and the spec finds no polygon. At 400 the mark is off-screen and hidden. The temporary lines were last changed 2026-10-19 (39cf3152).
e2e_failure.frontend_dev_said: slots 1.8, temporary M0 lines not updated: right in substance; the failure starts at 1.7
e2e_failure.fix: frontend-dev: show a room-engine mark only when the temporary scene has the product (anchor/outline, temp visible != false), or move the engine to the M0 1.2 lines; also a visible bug today: a 'magazine holder' mark floats over the rug at 1280
